title: Vulkan PACK
description: A lightweight Fabric 26.1.2 modpack focused on Vulkan-powered rendering, higher FPS, lower memory usage, and a smooth vanilla Minecraft experience.
body:
Vulkan Performance Pack

A lightweight performance-focused modpack for Minecraft Fabric 26.1.2

Vulkan Performance Pack is designed to deliver a smooth and optimized Minecraft experience while staying as close to vanilla gameplay as possible. This modpack focuses on improving rendering performance, reducing memory usage, and minimizing unnecessary overhead through a carefully selected collection of optimization mods.

Built around VulkanMod and several modern optimization projects, the pack is ideal for players seeking higher frame rates, faster world loading, and improved overall responsiveness without adding gameplay-altering content.

Features

- Optimized Vulkan-based rendering
- Improved FPS and frame stability
- Reduced RAM usage
- Faster game startup and world loading
- Enhanced chunk and entity rendering performance
- Lightweight and vanilla-friendly
- Multiplayer compatible
- Simple configuration through Mod Menu

Included Technologies

Performance

- VulkanMod
- Vulkan Dreno
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ModernFix
- ImmediatelyFast
- Krypton
- EntityCulling
- MoreCulling

Utilities & Quality of Life

- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config
- Mouse Tweaks
- AppleSkin
- LambDynamicLights

Dependencies

- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Placeholder API

System Requirements

Minimum

- Minecraft Fabric 26.1.2
- 4 GB RAM
- Vulkan-compatible graphics hardware

Recommended

- 8 GB RAM or higher
- Modern Vulkan-compatible GPU
- Latest graphics drivers

Philosophy

This modpack does not add new gameplay mechanics, items, dimensions, or progression systems. The primary goal is to maximize performance while preserving the original Minecraft experience.

Compatibility

Most Fabric mods should work normally; however, some rendering-related mods may be incompatible with VulkanMod. Always verify compatibility before adding additional mods.

Credits

All credit belongs to the original mod developers. This modpack simply bundles and configures existing projects to provide a streamlined performance-oriented experience.
